wet_karaz_order_member = {
  exists = yes
  has_government = democratic
  is_in_faction = yes
  faction_leader = {
    has_government = democratic
  }
  any_other_country = {
    exists = yes
    is_in_faction_with = U04
  }
}
wet_karaz_partner = {
  exists = yes
  NOT = {
    tag = U04
  }
  NOT = {
    tag = WST
  }
  NOT = {
    has_war_with = U04
  }
  NOT = {
    any_enemy_country = {
      is_in_faction_with = U04
    }
  }
  U04 = {
    exists = yes
  }
}
wet_karaz_route = {
  wet_karaz_partner = yes
  OR = {
    is_neighbor_of = U04
    AND = {
      U04 = {
        any_controlled_state = {
          naval_base
          >
          0
        }
        has_equipment = {
          convoy
          >
          0
        }
      }
      any_controlled_state = {
        naval_base
        >
        0
      }
    }
    U04 = {
      any_controlled_state = {
        can_build_railway = {
          start_state = THIS
          target_state = PREV.PREV.capital
          controller_priority = {
            base = -1
            modifier = {
              OR = {
                tag = U04
                gives_military_access_to = U04
                is_in_faction_with = U04
              }
              add = 2
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
